# State-level weather: validation (generated by `scripts/run_statepop_eval.py`)

Git commit `47c4998196`. MAE in MW. Differences are state-capital population-weighted minus 12-city equal-weight (negative = the state-level series is better), 95% block bootstrap.

## Horizon 1 h

| model | 12 cities, validation | state capitals, validation | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| ridge_full_rel | 1,094 | 1,095 | +1 (-1 to +4) |
| XGBoost S3_weatherA | 1,097 | 1,095 | -2 (-9 to +3) |
| XGBoost S4_full_A | 1,104 | 1,099 | -5 (-11 to +1) |
